description.p: Veem is a desktop email client for Wayland that feels at home in GNOME. It talks IMAP and SMTP directly, keeps your mail and credentials on your machine, and blocks trackers by default — no telemetry, no analytics.
Features:

ul.li: Multiple IMAP and POP3 accounts, with a unified All Inboxes view
Google, Microsoft and custom OAuth 2.0 sign-in, plus GNOME Online Accounts import
Whole-mailbox sync and search with infinite scroll
Deletions and moves made on other devices sync back automatically
Conversation threading, compose, reply, forward, and editable drafts
Remote content blocked by default; per-message light or dark reading
Passwords and OAuth tokens kept in the system keyring

description.p: Search and sort the attachments gallery, and see each attachment's date in its meta.
Attachment gallery icons are now colour-coded by file type — PDFs red, documents blue, spreadsheets green, and more.
Fixes newsletter subjects that showed as raw encoded text and stretched the window controls off-screen.
The Attachments gallery now spans every folder with a responsive 4:3 grid, right-click and double-click actions, and a hover Open button.
New Attachments gallery: browse every attachment across your inboxes in a grid, with thumbnails and a full-size preview.
Add Account now has a provider dropdown that auto-fills sign-in and server settings for iCloud, Yahoo, Proton, Google, Microsoft and more.
Desktop notifications for new mail and error alerts, with click-to-open and a toggle in Preferences.
Clickable links in plain-text emails, Delete/Backspace to delete in the message list, and an account-settings shortcut in the All Inboxes context menu.
Search now spans every folder of every account, with a selector to narrow it back to the current folder.
Reordered the reader's message-action buttons and tightened the message list to its minimum width.
Refreshes cached message renderings on upgrade, so mail read under an earlier version picks up the 1.1.3 body fixes.
Photos emailed from an iPhone now render inline and appear as attachments, instead of arriving as a blank message.
Fast, reliable mass delete/archive with correct Gmail Trash routing, plus live GNOME Online Accounts sync.
Fixed unreliable sidebar unread badges: stale counts after collapsing the sidebar, and inaccurate STATUS-based counts for inboxes on connect.
Compact sidebar: unread badges on inbox icons, per-account inboxes stay available when collapsed, and a narrower rail.
Added a Changelog section to the About window.
Quit cleanly when closing the window, fixing a spurious crash notification after the app had been running for a while.
Housekeeping: tidy up in-app links and bundled sample content.
First public release.
Manage GNOME Online Accounts from the account editor (enable/disable instead of remove), mark each account's source in the list, and route Google sign-in through GNOME Online Accounts.
Guide Google sign-in to GNOME Online Accounts from the account editor. Microsoft sign-in works out of the box.
Open sign-in and links through the desktop portal, so OAuth works inside the Flatpak sandbox. Flatpak packaging.
First stable release: multi-account IMAP/POP with OAuth, a unified inbox, whole-mailbox sync and search, conversation threading, and privacy-first reading.
